events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 years since the Las Vegas shooting
events.blurb: On September 7, 1996, rap icon Tupac Shakur was critically wounded in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas, dying six days later.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years ago this week, the music world was rocked by the shooting of Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas. His influence on hip-hop and culture remains undeniable.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: 56 years since his passing
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix died in London on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: 56 years ago, we lost a true innovator. Jimi Hendrix redefined what was possible with a guitar, leaving behind an incredible legacy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road': 57 years since its release
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: That famous zebra crossing! It's 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road', an album as iconic as its cover. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the distinctive voice and founding member of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Pretenders Frontwoman
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the inimitable Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon, her voice and attitude with The Pretenders continue to inspire.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that swagger and those anthems. What's your favourite Liam track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK single: 51 years on
events.blurb: John Lennon's enduring anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on October 24, 1975.

angles.name: Timeless Peace Anthem
angles.copy: More than just a song, it's a message. John Lennon's 'Imagine' hit the UK charts 51 years ago, and its call for peace is as relevant as ever.

events.title: The first iPod: 25 years since its debut
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod, revolutionising portable music, on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: Music in Your Pocket
angles.copy: Remember life before? It's 25 years since the first iPod dropped, changing how we listen to music forever. What was on your first one?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Raise a martini to 007, celebrating the anniversary of 'Dr. No'. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, the visionary co-founder of The Beatles, would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled artistry and enduring spirit of John Lennon. His music continues to resonate.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Sending a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album': 58 years on
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in the UK on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Iconic Double Album
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece that still sparks debate. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 years since his passing
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic frontman of Queen, died on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Unforgettable Performer
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we lost a legend. Freddie Mercury's incredible talent and stage presence continue to captivate generations.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul': 61 years on
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Pivotal Album
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' shifted their sound. A landmark album that influenced countless artists. What's your top pick from it?

events.title: John Lennon: 46 years since his passing
events.blurb: John Lennon was tragically shot and killed in New York City on December 8, 1980, at the age of 40.

angles.name: A Day of Remembrance
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world mourned the loss of John Lennon. His music and message of peace live on.
